summary: Disaster Desk: shipped the Titan submersible implosion long video (L-20261124-41, 558 s, 79 directed beats, NTSB and Coast Guard reports). It first stopped at the two-QA-round limit; the owner said 'Fix and resume', so the 6 notes were fixed and QA passed on round 3.
why: The owner's first pinned topic. Fact review passed after 1 rewrite, the number check and all render gates passed (peak -1.0 dB, mean -16.8 dB, liveliness ok), and QA passed on round 3 with the owner's go-ahead.

findings.title: The NTSB final report (MIR-25-36) is out and is the best source
findings.detail: Read in full from ntsb.gov (public domain). 30 sourced facts are now in the feed topic 2026-11-20-titan-submersible, and three report pages are in the licence log.

findings.title: Cross-section look: the white sheet counts as empty to the craft gate
findings.detail: It passes with a strong drafting grid (96 px, #cddae6). Sent to the improver as backlog item 2026-11-24-cross-section-empty.

findings.title: The render took about 5.5 hours on this cloud box
findings.detail: 14 chunks at 14-48 min each; the snowy-lot and sea-surface 3D scenes were the slowest. Long videos with this much 3D need about a 6-hour session.

changes.title: Shipped L-20261124-41: The Titan Submersible Implosion: What Really Happened
changes.detail: Thumbnail pick C ('They heard a bang'); A and B are on the video page. Chapters are in the description.

changes.title: Answered both of the owner's 23 Nov notes
